personality_one_liner: A sophisticated and clean management hub that elevates small business operations into a premium, highly functional experience.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native vertical spacing. Components should breathe. Cards must not be flush to the edge.

do's: Use glassmorphism on the bottom tab bar.
Use glassmorphism on sticky headers over scrolling content (e.g., Inventory list).
Use glassmorphism on the bottom sheet header/drag handle for the Multi-business switcher.
dont's: Never blur form fields or body text regions.
Do not use glass on every card or list row.

screens.name: Inicio (Dashboard)
screens.purpose: Quick overview of today's sales, active business, and urgent alerts like low stock.

states.loading: Centered spinner with a subtle brand tint.
states.empty: Illustration of a minimal workspace with a prompt to record the first sale.
states.error: Readable message ('Error al cargar datos') with a Retry button.

screens.layout: Header contains the Multi-business switcher (Dropdown pattern: Avatar + Name + Chevron). Below: Hero card for 'Ventas de Hoy' (Today's Sales) using a soft brandTertiary gradient. Followed by a horizontal scroll of 'Acciones Rápidas' (Nueva Venta, Nuevo Gasto). Bottom section: 'Alertas' (Low stock items) in a stacked list format with red/warning status dots.

screens.name: Inventario
screens.purpose: Manage products, track stock, and generate catalog.

states.loading: Skeleton loader matching the product grid layout.
states.empty: Empty box illustration + 'No hay productos en este negocio' + Primary CTA '+ Añadir Producto'.
states.error: Readable message with a Retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky top search bar with a glass background. Below: Segmented control (Todos, Bajo Stock). Main content: 2-column grid for products (Photo, Name, Price, Stock Badge). Floating Action Button (FAB) at bottom right for adding a product. Use a gradient scrim on product images if text is overlaid.

screens.name: Clientes
screens.purpose: CRM listing with WhatsApp integration and purchase history.

states.empty: Minimal contact illustration + 'No hay clientes registrados' + Primary CTA.
states.error: Readable message with a Retry button.

screens.layout: Standard iOS grouped list. Each row has an initials avatar (or photo), Name, and 'Última compra' date. Trailing icon is a WhatsApp button. Tapping the row opens a full-screen profile (Detail cover banner, notes, purchase history).

screens.name: Más (Settings & Finances)
screens.purpose: Access to business profile, financial reports, and PDF catalog generation.

states.error: Readable message with a Retry button.

screens.layout: iOS-style grouped list sections. Section 1: Perfil del Negocio (Name, Logo, Currency, Color). Section 2: Finanzas (Ingresos, Egresos, Capital). Section 3: Catálogo PDF. Use brandTertiary tinted icon containers for row icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a Top-bar Dropdown pattern for the Multi-business switcher: Avatar/Logo + Active Business Name + Chevron Down. Tapping it opens a @gorhom/bottom-sheet listing available businesses.

The app primarily targets iOS-Native Clean with an elegant champagne/gold palette. Ensure high contrast for text over gold (use the defined deep gold brandPrimary #9D7A2A to keep WCAG contrast intact).

For the Inventory grid, ensure a 2-column layout using flexWrap: 'wrap' and justifyContent: 'space-between' with dynamic width calculations. Do not leave single items orphaned with full width in a 2-col row.
Use glassmorphism (expo-glass-effect or expo-blur) extensively for sticky headers, the bottom tab bar, and the business switcher bottom sheet.
Any text overlaid on product images MUST include a top-to-bottom linear gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) to guarantee readability.
Always incorporate Loading/Empty/Error states for the main data screens (Inicio, Inventario, Clientes). Utilize the provided empty-state images.
Keep standard iOS spacing metrics and font weight discipline (no heavier than 500). Let Plus Jakarta Sans size drive the visual hierarchy.
